Name: AT Mayo Machine
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
My first contribution to the MCU (Mayo Content Universe).
Adds 4 textures of the mayo machine, one for each of the vanilla mayo flavors.
Regular mayo, duck mayo, void mayo, and dino mayo.
To change the texture, use the paint bucket on the mayo machine.

Downloads.Description: Adds 4 retextures of the mayo machine to match each flavor of mayo.
